preconditions.description: The number of words in the scroll is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The length of each word is at least 1 and the sum of lengths of all words does not exceed 20000.
Each word consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The output is the number of ways to get a version of the original scroll from the given scroll, modulo 10^9+7.
